formulas.expression:
"Corrective Action

" + "Corrective Action Required?: " + {!VarCorrectiveActionRequired} + "
" + "If Yes, Please Describe?: " + {!VarIfYesDescribe} + "

"

formulas.name: FORM_Electric_Safety
formulas.expression:
"Electrical Safety Test Checklist" + "

" + "Primary Measurements" + "
" + "Line Voltage (V): " + {!VarLineVoltageInputText} + "
" + "Device Current (A): " + {!VarDeviceCurrentInputText} + "
" + "Power Cord Resistance (mOhm): " + {!VarPowerCordResistanceInputText} + "

" + "Normal Polarity Test (Power On)" + "
" + "Ground Open (uA): " + {!VarNormPolOpenInputText} + "
" + "Ground Closed (uA): " + {!VarNormPolClosedInputText} + "

" + "Reverse Polarity Test (Power On)" + "
" + "Ground Open (uA): " + {!VarRevPolOpenInputText} + "
" + "Ground Closed (uA): " + {!VarRevPolClosedInputText} + "

" + "ECG Leakage Tests" + "
" + "Lead Leakage - Normal Condition (uA): " + {!VarLeadLeakageInputText} + "
" + "Lead Leakage - Normal Condition (P / F): " + {!Test_Lead_Leakage_Normal_Condition_P_F} + "

" + "Lead Isolation Test" + "
" + "Lead Isolation (uA): " + {!VarLeadIsolationInputText} + "
" + "Lead Isolation (P / F): " + {!Test_Lead_Isolation_P_F} + "
"

formulas.name: FORM_Preliminary_Checklist
formulas.expression:
"Preliminary

" + "Discuss Customer Concerns: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Discuss_Customer_Concerns}, {!Discuss_Customer_Concerns}) + "
" + "Verify Power Up: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Verify_Power_Up}, {!Verify_Power_Up}) + "
" + "Verify Boot Process: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Verify_Boot_Up_Process}, {!Verify_Boot_Up_Process}) + "
" + "Backup Preset & Network Settings: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Backup_Preset_Network_Settings}, {!Backup_Preset_Network_Settings}) + "

" + "Review Error Logs if Applicable: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Review_Error_Logs_If_Applicable}, {!Review_Error_Logs_If_Applicable}) + "
" + "Run System Diagnostics if Available: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Run_System_Diagnostics_If_Applicable}, {!Run_System_Diagnostics_If_Applicable}) + "
" + "Verify Database: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Verify_Database}, {!Verify_Database}) + "
" + "Perform Hard Drive Maintenance: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Perform_Hard_Drive_Maintenance}, {!Perform_Hard_Drive_Maintenance}) + "
" + "Transducers Cleaned After Each Use: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Transducers_Cleaned_After_Each_Use}, {!Transducers_Cleaned_After_Each_Use}) + "

" + "Inspection and Cleaning

" + "Clean and Inspect System Interior: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Clean_and_Inspect_System_Interior}, {!Clean_and_Inspect_System_Interior}) + "
" + "Check System Fans: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Check_Systems_Fans}, {!Check_Systems_Fans}) + "
" + "Clean System Filters: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Clean_Systems_Filters}, {!Clean_Systems_Filters}) + "
" + "Clean System Monitor, Touch Panel: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Clean_System_Monitor_Touch_Panel}, {!Clean_System_Monitor_Touch_Panel}) + "
" + "Clean Trackball: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Clean_Trackball}, {!Clean_Trackball}) + "
" + "Hospital Grade Plug: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Hospital_Grade_Plug}, {!Hospital_Grade_Plug}) + "
" + "Inspect Accessories, Peripherals for Proper Security: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Inspect_Accessories_Peripherals_for_Proper_Security}, {!Inspect_Accessories_Peripherals_for_Proper_Security}) + "
" + "Wheels Securely Attached and Rotate Properly: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Wheels_Securely_Attached_Rotate_Properly}, {!Wheels_Securely_Attached_Rotate_Properly}) + "
" + "Wheel Locks Functional: " + BLANKVALUE({!Copy_2_of_Wheel_Locks_Functional}, {!Wheel_Locks_Functional}) + "
" + {!FROM_Preliminary_Checklist_2}

formulas.name: FORM_Test_Equipment

"Test Equipment
